outgoing.name: Arabic language
outgoing.excerpt: The name Algol means "demon star," (from Arabic الغول al-ghūl, "the ghoul") which was probably given due to its peculiar behaviour.

outgoing.name: Astrology
outgoing.excerpt: Astrologically, Algol is considered the most unfortunate star in the sky.

outgoing.name: Diamond
outgoing.excerpt: In the Middle Ages it was one of the 15 Behenian stars, associated with the diamond and hellebore, and marked with the kabbalistic sign .
